verdict.rationale: Rive ships a built-in AI agent in the editor that helps with design work, generating scripts, responsive layouts, data models and animation. Its MCP tools also automate repetitive tasks such as building view models, state machines, layouts and shapes. None of the asset chores the story names are evidenced, so this is in-editor AI for structural and animation work rather than asset work. Missing for 10: AI image generation, background removal, content-aware fill, copy/text suggestions, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of the AI agent.
